zh: 海德堡大学（Ruprecht-Karls-Universität Heidelberg）成立于1386年，位于德国巴登-符腾堡州海德堡市，是德国历史最悠久的大学之一，也是欧洲顶尖的研究型大学。学校在医学、自然科学、法学、社会科学、人文艺术等领域享有盛誉，其学术研究水平位居世界前列。海德堡大学以其深厚的学术传统和优美的校园环境，培养了大量各领域的杰出人才。
en: Ruprecht-Karls-Universität Heidelberg, founded in 1386, is one of Germany's oldest universities and a leading European research institution in Heidelberg, Baden-Württemberg. It excels in medicine, natural sciences, law, social sciences, humanities, and more, with world-leading academic research. Known for its profound academic tradition and beautiful campus, Heidelberg University has produced numerous talents across fields.
